title: Best Search Ads Strategy Consultants (2026): Plan Paid Search
description: How to hire a search engine marketing strategist for paid search audits, keyword plans and budgets: deliverables, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: SEM strategy consultants plan your paid search advertising: which keywords to target, how to structure campaigns, how much to spend and how to measure profit. They often start with an audit of existing accounts. Good strategy stops wasted spend and focuses budget on searches that bring customers. It goes wrong when advice ignores your margins, tracking is broken or the consultant wants full control of your accounts. This guide helps you get a paid search plan that pays off.

faq.q: Is this the same as managing ads?
faq.a: Strategy plans and audits; management runs daily optimization. Some consultants offer both.

faq.q: How much budget do I need?
